beats.text: I tested them. It's only this chair, on this floorboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll lift the floorboards. The chairs have exposed a flooring problem.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're opening in twenty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll close for renovations. Once the floor's up, we can move the counter and sort out the queue.

records.mechanism: D48 promotes a minor problem into a rationale for solving larger and more disruptive surrounding problems.
records.confusableConcept: Broad inspection alone can be reasonable caution; the card requires using the small issue to justify a growing intervention.
records.distinguishingEvidence: Original A5 names no repair; revised A3 proposes lifting the floor and revised A5 closes the café to alter its layout.
records.alternativeComparison: The café alternative adds imminent opening and business closure; the domestic tap alternative expands through connected kitchen fittings.
records.reason: Introduced a café setting to give the broader repair a concrete cost. Internal reread scores 5/5/4/5/5/4, total 95; B4's opening deadline causes A5 to convert repairs into a renovation closure. Hard gates pass.
records.reservation: The jump from one floorboard to renovation is intentionally excessive; A must sincerely believe the larger closure is useful.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 recruits a badge-wearing deputy, and A3 explicitly rejects shared direction in obtaining help.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 directly answers B2's co-organiser request; A5 answers B4's duties question only in general terms.

relationship.evidence: B2 seeks equal standing and B4 asks what work the subordinate role actually entails.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands duties to 'everything' but names no task, limit, or new exercise of direction.

specificity.evidence: A1's raffle and deputy badge establish recruitment clearly, but A5 leaves the actual helping activity unspecified.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'not a second direction' is concise and exact; A5 is a more generic delegation formula.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need help running the raffle. I've made you a deputy badge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why not co-organiser?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You'll sell the tickets; I'll decide when we draw. One clear chain of command.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The ticket queue is already round the hall. Come help me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll stand beside you and authorise extra ticket sellers. You can start recruiting them.

records.mechanism: D49 obtains needed help by defining the helper's work as service directed by A.
records.confusableConcept: Generic bossiness asserts authority without using the subordinate role to recruit someone into helping.
records.distinguishingEvidence: A1 makes the need for raffle help explicit; revised A3 assigns execution to B and revised A5 turns B's request for help into directed recruitment.
records.alternativeComparison: This alternative uses an operational overload to expand supervised help; D49-single-b turns an objection to unequal partnership into a first assignment.
records.reason: Kept the raffle, badge, and co-organiser exchange while specifying the work. Internal reread scores 5/5/4/4/5/4, total 92; B4's queue pressure causes A5 to recruit through the deputy. Hard gates pass.
records.reservation: A's offer to stand alongside B must register as sincere assistance, despite preserving the supervisory role; provenance rebinding remains separately qualified.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 recruits a second-in-command; A3 allocates execution to B and all direction to A.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 specifically reinterprets B2's equal work proposal, and A5 converts B4's equality objection into a wording assignment.

relationship.evidence: B2 proposes a credible shared arrangement and B4 identifies A's inequity, forcing a new recruiting tactic.

heightening.evidence: A5 treats B's resistance as the first act of subordinate service, moving from proposed rank to an actual assignment.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes picnic organizing and the offered role in one natural recruiting sentence.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's half/all contrast and A5's wording assignment are concise expressions of the same controlling logic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come organise the picnic as my second-in-command.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could share the work equally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. You execute half; I direct all of it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That isn't equal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your first assignment is improving the wording.

records.mechanism: D49 frames recruitment as subordinate service and absorbs negotiation into work performed under A's direction.
records.confusableConcept: Winning a status argument alone does not require persuading or assigning the other person to help.
records.distinguishingEvidence: A1 asks B to organize the picnic, A3 assigns execution, and A5 makes B's objection into a concrete first assignment.
records.alternativeComparison: This alternative recruits through semantic control over equality; the revised raffle alternative recruits additional labor through an operational crisis.
records.reason: Retained after rereading because B4 directly supplies the subject of A5's assignment, making the final turn an enactment of recruitment.
records.reservation: A3 states the hierarchy bluntly; sincere confidence in efficient organization is needed to keep A from becoming merely taunting.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 separates shift completion from permission to leave, and A5 subjects going home to A's approval.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 absorbs B2's fifteen-minute overrun into a review; A5 converts B4's departure announcement into another approval requirement.

relationship.evidence: B2 asserts the elapsed time and B4 attempts to leave, progressively challenging A's claimed control.

heightening.evidence: A5 extends dismissal control into permission for a change of location after B4 rejects waiting.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes an ended work shift and B2 supplies the actual time, though the dismissal review is invented abruptly.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's punctual attendance at an overdue review and A5's location approval maintain one concise bureaucratic voice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your shift ends at five. Your dismissal is still pending.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's five fifteen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You've demonstrated punctual attendance at the dismissal review.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll need to approve your change of location.

records.mechanism: D50 keeps B present by making departure depend on permission A claims sole authority to grant.
records.confusableConcept: General bureaucracy routes many activities through procedure; this drive uses procedure specifically to withhold release.
records.distinguishingEvidence: A1 denies that the shift ending authorizes departure, and A5 invents location approval only after B4 tries to go home.
records.alternativeComparison: This alternative exploits a workplace authority claim; D50-single-b imports permission to leave into a voluntary social encounter.
records.reason: Retained after rereading because both time-based resistance and attempted departure become fresh reasons to keep B awaiting authorization.
records.reservation: The workplace rank remains implicit, and the invented review is deliberately implausible; the comic authority should remain specific to release.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 makes B's coat conditional on permission, but A5 redirects dismissal toward the café instead of clearly keeping B present.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 formalizes B2's coffee encounter; A5 mentions B4's closing café but does not explain how its dismissal retains B.

relationship.evidence: B2 disputes the social authority and B4 supplies an external closing constraint that should change A's tactic.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands the object of dismissal absurdly without developing a workable means of delaying B's departure.

specificity.evidence: A1's coat and B2's coffee locate a departure moment, sharpened by B4's café closure.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 is short but depends on the detached image of dismissing a café rather than the established interpersonal hold.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you put your coat on, I'd like to formally conclude our coffee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only stopped for ten minutes. My bus is due.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll consider an early departure. Sit down while I decide.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The café's closing. They've asked us both to leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. We'll wait outside together. Their permission to leave doesn't replace mine.

records.mechanism: D50 claims the right to authorize B's departure and preserves that claim when circumstances require a new location.
records.confusableConcept: Wanting more company may ask B to stay; this card treats leaving as a privilege A must approve.
records.distinguishingEvidence: Original A5 dismisses the venue; revised A3 makes departure an application and revised A5 keeps B waiting for A's separate permission outside.
records.alternativeComparison: The social alternative must invent authority between coffee companions and adapt to venue closure; the work scene relies on an existing shift structure.
records.reason: Kept the café and coat while adding a bus deadline. Internal reread scores 5/5/4/4/5/4, total 92; B4 causes A5 to relocate the permission wait without releasing B. Hard gates pass.
records.reservation: A's social authority is intentionally unearned; performance must preserve sincere entitlement without implying physical restraint.
